reviewer: claude-opus-5.5 (same session as the builder — not an independent review)
method: contact sheet (16 auto times) + per-seam strips (4 frames per seam at 0.1 s) + full-res crops of keyframes + 4 frames extracted from the encoded MP4
iterations: v1: everything too small for a phone; '，' token started a new row; s5 headline orphaned one character -> bigger type scale, punctuation-aware wrap, fit-to-width headline
v2: validators flagged S3 (note held 0.9 s < 1.0 s), V1 (captions 2 px above safe area under camera push; s3 note 33 px into bottom UI zone; s5 headline at side margins) -> retimed and moved
v3: seam strips showed a ~0.25 s near-empty gap at 2.50 s (scene self-fade + transition double fade) and double exposure in push/fade -> composition owns transitions, staged out/in

v4 (after cross-agent evals): append-loop lays out on the final sentence so chips never jump rows (raised by the Sonnet 5.5 reviewer in E7); ending kicker now calls back 「说话」 (M5, suggested by two agent runs); support-vs-accent colour rule clarified in the style guide

checks.note: 核心说法正确（逐 token 预测、按概率选择、接上再预测）。两处简化已在画面标注：token 编号与概率均写了「仅为示意」。另有未标注的简化：真实模型并不总是选概率最高的词（可能采样），中文分词方式也因模型而异——15 秒科普可接受，若做系列可在后续视频补充。
5 个场景首末帧都有可见变化：标题升起+下划线、句子裂成 token、概率条增长并选中、句子逐词变长、结论与术语徽章出现。
每个关键帧只有一个主焦点。s4 的句子现在按最终长度一次排好两行（今天天气真 / 好，适合出门），逐词出现时方块不再换行跳动；读数框位置固定。
未出现禁用清单中的效果；强调色只有橙色，蓝色是 support 数据色（风格指南已明确不算强调色）；字体与圆角一致。
结尾的引导语改为「这就是 AI 的“说话”」，直接回扣开头的问题；回顾行再现中段的句子母题。
